reviewNotes: ADMIT-BACKSTAGE. MTN currently documents Keep My Number for prepaid at NGN3,500/1y, NGN5,000/2y and NGN7,500/3y. Current prepaid terms also correct the legacy NIN assumption: visitors staying under 24 months are exempt from NIN linkage for purchase but must present a valid visa plus passport/travel document. No public recommendation or roaming/OTP reliability claim follows from this admission.

events.outcome: Current MTN prices are NGN3,500/1 year, NGN5,000/2 years and NGN7,500/3 years. Current prepaid terms also establish a visitor registration path without NIN for stays under 24 months, subject to valid visa and passport/travel documentation.

data.acquisitionSummary: MTN prepaid lines can use the dedicated Keep My Number service. SIM registration is required; visitors staying under 24 months do not need a NIN for purchase but do need a valid visa and international passport/travel document. A revenue-generating event is required within 48 hours after registration.

keep.action: Keep My Number plans are NGN3,500/1 year, NGN5,000/2 years and NGN7,500/3 years. The 3-year option has the lowest annualized current provider price. Fund sufficient airtime, then subscribe with *365# / *365*3# or the corresponding SMS keyword.

data.chinaActivation: Initial SIM registration/activation is a Nigeria-side process in current provider terms; remote China-first acquisition is not established.
data.kyc: NIN is generally required, but visitors staying less than 24 months are expressly exempt from the NIN purchase requirement if they provide a valid visa and international passport/travel document.
data.payment: Keep My Number subscription is deducted from sufficient airtime balance; remote foreign-card/top-up reliability is not established.
data.tariffSummary: Keep My Number: NGN3,500/1y, NGN5,000/2y, NGN7,500/3y; 3y = NGN2,500/year annualized.
guideSteps: Register and activate the prepaid line with the applicable identity documents.
Perform the required revenue-generating event after registration.
Fund sufficient airtime and subscribe to the chosen Keep My Number duration using the official *365# flow.
